intro: With two pronouns, the person who receives comes first and then the thing. Before lo, la, los and las, «le» and «les» become «se».
p.me lo.consejo: First who receives, then the thing: «me lo das». Never the other way: you do not say «lo me das».
p.te la.consejo: The order is always person + thing: «te la presto» (the key). Here «la» replaces a feminine thing.
p.se lo.glosa: to him, her or you (ustedes) + it
p.se lo.consejo: Before «lo», «le» changes to «se»: you do not say «le lo doy», but «se lo doy».
p.se las.glosa: to him, her or them + them
p.se las.consejo: «Les» also becomes «se» before «las»: «les mando las fotos» → «se las mando».
p.nos los.consejo: With «nos» nothing changes: «nos los enseña». First «nos», then «los».
p.devuelves.consejo: From «devolver»: o becomes «ue» (devuelvo, devuelves), but «devolvemos». The v sounds like b.
p.enseña.consejo: From «enseñar»: to show something or to teach. The «ñ» sounds like «ny»: en-SE-nya.
p.mando.consejo: From «mandar»: to send. «Te mando un mensaje» and «se lo mando a Ana» are very normal sentences.
p.el paraguas.consejo: It is masculine and does not change in the plural: «el paraguas», «los paraguas». Hence: «te lo presto».
p.la llave.consejo: Feminine: «la llave» becomes «la». The «ll» sounds like a y: YA-be.
p.las fotos.consejo: «Foto» is feminine although it ends in o: it is short for «fotografía». Hence «las fotos».
p.el piso.consejo: In Spain, a «piso» is a flat. It is also each floor of a building.
p.ahora mismo.consejo: «Mismo» reinforces «ahora»: it means «at this very moment». It is written as two words.
b1.titulo: First who receives, then the thing
b1.texto:
When there are **two pronouns**, the order never changes: **who receives + the thing**. Both go together, **before the verb**.

- **Me lo** das. **Te la** presto. **Nos los** manda. **Os lo** doy.

Before **lo, la, los, las**, the pronouns **le** and **les** become **se**:

- Le doy el libro a Ana. → **Se lo** doy. (not «le lo»)
- Les mando las fotos. → **Se las** mando.

This **se** can mean he, she, they or you (ustedes). If it is not clear, add **a Ana**, **a ellos**, **a usted**.

**No** goes before both: **no se lo** doy.
b2.f0.texto: Will you lend me the umbrella?
b2.f1.texto: Yes, I will lend it to you.
b2.f2.texto: When will you give it back to me?
b2.f3.texto: You give it back to me tomorrow.
b2.f4.texto: Who is sending Ana the photos?
b2.f5.texto: I am sending them to her right now.
b2.f6.texto: The key, I give it to your brother.
b2.f7.texto: He always gives it back to us.
b4.titulo: Change the noun for the second pronoun
b4.texto:
First write the sentence with nouns. Then change the thing for **lo, la, los, las** and keep the receiver in front:

- Me das el libro. → **Me lo** das.
- Te presto la llave. → **Te la** presto.
- Le doy el libro a Ana. → **Se lo** doy.
- Les mando las fotos. → **Se las** mando.
- Nos enseña el piso. → **Nos lo** enseña.
- Os doy el libro. → **Os lo** doy.

Only **le** and **les** change: they become **se**. The others stay the same.
b4.e0.texto: I will lend it to you today.
b4.e1.texto: I do not give it to Pablo.
b5.f0.texto: The rain has been beating on the office windows since the morning.
b5.f1.texto: Lucía looks at the grey sky and cannot find her umbrella.
b5.f2.texto: Her colleague Pablo keeps a blue umbrella under the table.
b5.f3.texto: He offers it to her with a calm smile.
b5.f4.texto: She thanks him for it and goes out into the wet street.
b5.f5.texto: The water falls in thick drops on the blue plastic.
b5.f6.texto: The lights of the cars shine on the wet ground.
b5.f7.texto: Lucía walks slowly and thinks about the photos from the party.
b5.f8.texto: That night Lucía sends them to all her friends.
b5.f9.texto: The next day Lucía gives it back to him clean and dry.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Le lo» is never said. It has to change.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Ana receives the book, so a receiver pronoun is needed.
b6.pregunta: I give the book to Ana. Which pronoun is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Les las» does not exist. Before «las», «les» becomes «se».
b7.o2.refuerzo: The receiver goes first: se las, not «las se».
b7.pregunta: «¿Les mandas las fotos a tus padres?» Which is the answer?
b8.traduccion: I am sending them to her right now
b9.o1.refuerzo: That is it! A feminine, singular thing: la.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Le» is for who receives. The key is the thing.
b10.pregunta: Change «el paraguas» to «lo»: «Te presto el paraguas».
b11.o0.refuerzo: That is the wrong one: it has to be «se lo doy».
b11.o1.refuerzo: It is fine. It is the correct form, so it is not the answer.
b11.o2.refuerzo: It is fine: «me» does not change. Look for the wrongly written sentence.
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Se» is for him, her or them. Here it is us.
b12.o1.refuerzo: «Os» is for vosotros. We are talking about us.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Well done! With «nos» nothing changes: nos lo.
b12.pregunta: Ana shows the flat to us. What is missing?
p.agradece.consejo: From «agradecer». The c before e is a «th» in Spain, so say it like «a-gra-DE-the».
p.gruesas.consejo: The ue sounds like «gwe» here. Gruesa is the feminine form of grueso.
p.húmedo.consejo: The h is silent. The stress falls on the first syllable because of the accent mark.
